purpose: The single list of what is broken across Anthony's estate. Every item carries a shell command that exits 0 when the defect is gone. Status is never stored here; it is computed each morning into state/defects-status.json and rendered at the top of the boot pack.

severity.P1: a lane lies or is degraded

owner.anthony: a decision, a merge, or a message only Anthony can make
owner.session: needs a supervised session on this Mac (judgment or local state)
owner.codex: the nightly lane may take it without anyone present
owner.jay: an outside collaborator (Jay), who deploys what a session commits

fix_scope.repo-pr: fixable by a pull request from a fresh clone (nightly-eligible)
fix_scope.local: touches this Mac's state or existing checkouts (supervised session; ff-only syncs need Anthony's ruling)

size.S: a short repair; the only size the nightly lane may take

rules.verify: run with bash -c from $HOME, 60 s timeout, PATH prefixed with /opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$HOME/.local/bin; exit 0 = fixed, anything else = open, timeout = error. Output is never rendered into the boot pack, only a 300-char stderr tail into the status file.
rules.pr_check: optional; a command the nightly lane runs INSIDE its fresh clone to prove a PR is sound before opening it (the real verify usually passes only after merge)
rules.provisional: true means the verify is a placeholder that always fails; counted separately, never assigned to the nightly lane; the fix includes writing a real verify
rules.not_before: ISO date before which nobody touches the item (rendered as deferred)
rules.closing: an item whose verify passes on two consecutive mornings is removed from this file by the next session or by the nightly lane's housekeeping PR; the status file keeps its fixed_at date for the 'fixed since yesterday' line
rules.private: anything that would name a client (a repository, a fork, a URL, a list of pull requests) never sits in this file (P25: client names never land in a networked repo). It lives in ~/.config/fully-aware/defects.env as KEY=VALUE lines; every verify receives those as $DEFECT_* variables and must exit 1 when the one it needs is empty
